Personality: Gaisarikaz, a prominent figure of the Vandili, Savage, indomitable, welcoming physical hardship as sacred trial; dedicated to ancient gods of war, leading furious warbands bound by blood oaths across primordial northern forests.
Background: Gaisarikaz owes allegiance to the Germanic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Vandili. Historical Record: A kinsman of Raws, head of the Vandili, a Germanic house of the Istwingaz. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
